title: Add site-wide Google Ads website-call tracking
entry_text: Deployed site-wide tracking for calls from eligible Google Ads website visitors. Calls lasting at least 60 seconds count toward the new secondary conversion action. Existing dedicated campaign tracking remains in place. This is a measurement change: an increase in recorded calls may reflect improved tracking rather than more actual inquiries.
evidence: The SEO task reported PR #69 merged, deployment successful, and the production tag and call-tracking library verified on September 12. Tracking was set to secondary, not a new bidding goal. Review this proposed effective date before adding.

title: Connect the smile gallery to treatment-planning content
entry_text: Added internal links between the smile gallery and smile-makeover planning content, giving visitors a clearer path from results to treatment information.
evidence: Repository history shows PR #68 merged September 2. The merge establishes a code change, not its live deployment date. Confirm production implementation before adding. No patient case details are included.
